label: Experimental · Fast WASD gait · 125 mm/s command
description: Hold W/S for forward/reverse and combine with A/D to steer. Release to finish the foot transfer and brake. Walking turns; no pivot turn.
readiness: Experimental faster gait. Sustained motion checked; slipping remains. Browser performance is under evaluation.
evidence: 60 s at 0.625 ms: 126.7–128.8 mm/s, 8.5% loaded-foot slip. Release stopped within 0.26 s / 7 mm. Frozen commands stopped within 0.48 s / 37 mm. This 5 ms preview differs from the 1.25 ms path by up to 10 mm. Provisional actuator model and ideal observations.
